name: Quest Lodge v1 — Exterior vs Tutorial Island reference
subtitle: Gabled hall with east-west ridge, half-octagonal chart turret, covered east porch, scroll-and-star finial
review_note: The lodge reads as a distinct third composition beside the Guide Hall and Kitchen: a cross-axis gable, an engaged polygonal turret, and a real porch that composes the arrival instead of a door cut in a wall. Fieldstone base, timber bays, fitted doors, shuttered windows and the notice-lantern all read at the game camera. Held below 9.0: the gable tile courses read as a flat diagonal pattern, the porch rails and balusters are plain boxes, and the turret roof courses are still boxy slabs.
improve: Give the gable a stepped shingle profile like the Workyard, turn the porch balusters into turned spindles, and add a carved sign board with a painted quest scroll above the porch step.
